2608.18938.title: Breaking the weakest link to evade vision language models
2608.18938.paper_summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have recently emerged as a critical component of multimodal AI systems, enabling joint reasoning over visual and textual inputs in real-world and safety-critical applications. Despite their growing deployment, the robustness of VLMs against adversarial threats remains insufficiently explored, particularly in the context of evasion attacks targeting multimodal alignment. In this work, we investigate the vulnerability of VLMs to adversarial perturbations applied to visual inputs and study two attack settings: untargeted attacks, where the goal is to disrupt the model's interpretation of the original image, and targeted attacks, where the adversary aims to force the model to generate a specific semantic description unrelated to the original image. To efficiently generate adversarial examples, we propose a gradient-based attack method that performs optimization exclusively on the vision encoder of the VLM rather than on the entire multimodal architecture. This design significantly reduces the computational cost and resource requirements of the attack while maintaining strong effectiveness. We evaluate our approach on several open-source VLMs, including Qwen2.5-VL, Granite-Vision, FastVLM, and Phi-3.5-Vision, and show that small, human-imperceptible perturbations can substantially alter the textual interpretation produced by the models. Our findings highlight the vulnerability of modern VLMs to adversarial manipulation and emphasize the need for improved robustness and security mechanisms in multimodal AI systems.
2608.18938.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLMs）最近成為多模態人工智慧系統的重要組成部分，使得在現實世界和安全關鍵應用中能夠對視覺和文本輸入進行聯合推理。儘管它們的部署越來越多，但VLMs對於對抗威脅的穩健性仍然未被充分探索，特別是在針對多模態對齊的逃避攻擊背景下。在這項工作中，我們調查了VLMs對施加於視覺輸入的對抗擾動的脆弱性，並研究了兩種攻擊設置：無目標攻擊，其目標是破壞模型對原始圖像的解釋，以及有目標攻擊，對手旨在迫使模型生成與原始圖像無關的特定語義描述。為了有效生成對抗樣本，我們提出了一種基於梯度的攻擊方法，該方法僅在VLM的視覺編碼器上進行優化，而不是在整個多模態架構上。這種設計顯著降低了攻擊的計算成本和資源需求，同時保持了強大的有效性。我們在幾個開源VLM上評估我們的方法，包括Qwen2.5-VL、Granite-Vision、FastVLM和Phi-3.5-Vision，並顯示出小的、人類無法察覺的擾動可以顯著改變模型產生的文本解釋。我們的發現突顯了現代VLMs對對抗操控的脆弱性，並強調了在多模態人工智慧系統中改善穩健性和安全機制的必要性。
